BJP Responds to Rahul Gandhi's 'Vote Theft' Allegations

Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) spokesperson Sudhanshu Trivedi responded to Congress leader Rahul Gandhi's allegations of 'vote theft'. Trivedi dismissed Gandhi's claims, stating that Gandhi was exaggerating media reports and lacked political knowledge. Trivedi questioned the basis of a report Gandhi had referenced and suggested Gandhi's accusations stemmed from envy of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and his party's electoral losses. The BJP also stated there were no changes to Form-6.
